g.text: Title: Long-range remote LITE - LED head (4 x AA NiMH)

g.desc: Title: Long-range remote LITE - LED head (4 x AA NiMH)

g.text: 66 x SFH 4545 950nm, 33 strings of 2, 24R, from the 4 x AA NiMH pack, 99.8 x 44.8 mm

g.desc: 66 x SFH 4545 950nm, 33 strings of 2, 24R, from the 4 x AA NiMH pack, 99.8 x 44.8 mm

g.text: LITE LED head: 66 x Osram SFH 4545 (950nm, +/-5deg) - 33 strings of 2 on the 4 x AA NiMH pack

g.desc: LITE LED head: 66 x Osram SFH 4545 (950nm, +/-5deg) - 33 strings of 2 on the 4 x AA NiMH pack

g.text: I = (VBAT - 2 x 1.5V) / 24R: 100mA on fresh cells (5.4V), 75-83mA for most of the discharge. ~3A peak, ~0.9A average while sending; switched at 38/40kHz by the control board (one low-side switch on LED_RTN; the supply itself is only on while ARM is high).

g.desc: I = (VBAT - 2 x 1.5V) / 24R: 100mA on fresh cells (5.4V), 75-83mA for most of the discharge. ~3A peak, ~0.9A average while sending; switched at 38/40kHz by the control board (one low-side switch on LED_RTN; the supply itself is only on while ARM is high).

g.text: 14 x 5 grid, corners empty (M3 holes): rows of 6 / 7 / 7 / 7 / 6 strings, none crosses rows. Resistors on the back.

g.desc: 14 x 5 grid, corners empty (M3 holes): rows of 6 / 7 / 7 / 7 / 6 strings, none crosses rows. Resistors on the back.

g.text: J1 - 2x5 0.1in pin header to control board J5 (pin n = pin n)

g.desc: J1 - 2x5 0.1in pin header to control board J5 (pin n = pin n)

g.text: Odd pins = LED_PWR, even pins = LED_RTN. Fitted on the BACK of the board.

g.desc: Odd pins = LED_PWR, even pins = LED_RTN. Fitted on the BACK of the board.
